preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.
The number of edges E is between 0 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V and 1 <= w <= 99 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects valid vertices u and v with a weight w between 1 and 99.
The source s and destination t are valid vertex indices.
The number of edge lines matches the declared E.

postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of the number of distinct shortest paths from s to t.

postconditions.expression: count_shortest_paths(V, edges, s, t) == sum(1 for p in all_paths(V, edges, s, t) if path_length(p, edges) == shortest_distance(V, edges, s, t))
postconditions.description: The count equals the number of paths from s to t whose total weight equals the minimum possible distance between s and t.
